listingTitle: Replace a repeated dictionary shape with a type
title: Replace a repeated dictionary shape with a type
why: A stable domain shape passed through generic dictionaries distributes field names, validation, and evolution across callers instead of giving the concept one explicit contract.
suggestion: Introduce a dataclass, TypedDict, Pydantic model, or domain class when these keys share identity and lifecycle.
limitations: Requires the same complete set of four to twelve literal keys on a generic or untyped parameter in at least three functions across two files, or at least four functions in one file.
Only direct string-literal indexing and get, pop, or setdefault calls are recognized; aliases, computed keys, partial shape overlap, and interprocedural value flow are not resolved.
Explicitly typed non-mapping parameters, test functions, comments, string examples, local dictionaries, and shapes below the project-level repetition threshold are excluded.
